sections.heading: MINOR IN RELIGIOUS STUDIES (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Faculty of Arts and Humanities

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.
Completion of first-year requirements and at least a 0.5 course in Religious Studies with a mark of at least 60%.
2.0 courses in Religious Studies: at the 2100 level or above.
2.0 courses in Religious Studies: at the 2200 level or above.
Note: Students may complete either the Minor in Religious Studies or the Minor in Religious Studies and Philosophy, but not both, offered by Brescia University College.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
